decisions.reason: Cites LinkType=Junction/Target and the link marker, concludes the repo is the installed copy, calls copying a category error (same file record, no-op at best), and contrasts copied/registry installs needing package-manager reinstall.

Assigns the EBUSY handles and stale modules to the running host PID, shows tab close cannot release them, separately explains browser HTTP-cache replay and boot-time bundle caching, and requires restart plus hard refresh; keeps browser caching distinct from the filesystem lock.

Explains path resolution through the junction renamed the single underlying entry and the source copy then failed; recovery stops the host first (valid precaution), renames both .old2 back, verifies with node --check, then activates; no file recreation.

States non-negotiable order: fully stop all host processes, restart dsh web, hard refresh once after restart, then verify served bytes, new route, console/roster and behavior; refresh-only or tab close explicitly insufficient.

§5 requires LinkType/Target, marker and lockfile checks before touching any file, with a linked-vs-copied action table, and explains how copy-into-node_modules advice encoded a false topology and drove destructive escalation.

caps.reason: Final procedures copy nothing through the junction; copying appears only as the rejected error being diagnosed.
All activation paths include full host stop and restart; browser-only activation is identified as the incident's mistake, not advised.
